reviews.x: Love this co-wash! I have long, straight, fine, color-treated Caucasian hair. I must wash my hair daily. This type of 1-step cleansing conditioner is ideal so my hair isn’t stripped. My hair is healthy, soft, tangle free, etc. Smell is very nice, not overwhelming. Product goes further too so I can use less. I have tried many, this is a fave!

I've used Aussie Curls for a few years and absolutely love the product!  I was having a hard time finding it in stores since covid, and thankfully found it on Amazon.  I've tried nearly every curl product on the market, from cheap to over $100 per gallon, and Aussie Curls co-wash is the BEST!  I use co-wash and the conditioner and my curls are so soft and manageable.  Regular curl products leave my hair a tangled mess when washing, but not with Aussie Curls Co-wash!  Try it, you'll love it!

I can’t believe that they don’t charge more for this! I have tried so many expensive brands but never had the results I get from Aussie’s co-wash. It’s even better that I can buy it in bulk. 5 stars for a company that puts out a great product for a fair price. My naturally curly hair has never looked better and I get so many compliments now that it doesn’t look so dry and frizzy.
Love this i have very wavy kinda curly coarse hair this makes my waves soft and shiney

reviews.t: Cleans my fine, long, wavy blonde hair!
reviews.x: So I am an idiot and I originally bought this in the store thinking it was the three minute miracle deep conditioner. For a while I was using it like a deep conditioner and I was wondering why my hair wasn’t working so hydrated. Finally I looked at the bottle and I realize I bought the wrong bottle LOL. I’m not the brightest. So I decided to use the stuff how it was meant to be used, as a cleansing conditioner. I have long, fine blonde hair that is wavy and I have dry ends, but my roots gets oil

It dispenses better than the other brands. The price is AMAZING!!  I cannot recommend this product enough. Get it now 😊
Aussie Co Wash  shampoo is the best. It leaves your hair soft and manageable without stripping it with harsh chemicals. Perfect for restoring and refreshing coarse hair to curls.

Love this product! It makes my curls soft, moist, and easy to manage. I get complements about my curls when I use it.  But I just realized they only sent me to of the product and one of the products was different.

I accidently bought this instead of a deep conditioner and loved it. I've been straightening my hair for years and with this product I am starting to embrace my naturally wavy/curly hair. It cleans really well but doesn't strip out the oils and doesn't leave it too greasy. It doesn't weigh down the curls. My hair feels soft and smells good. I just add some gel and let it air dry then finger style it. I finally found something that works.

I'm washing my hair with shampoo every 2-3 days and using this in between. I have oily scalp but my hair is course and dry. Trying train my hair using this and it helps condition daily but also remove a little oil so i don't look gross.

reviews.t: The clear winner for my hair

I don't have curly hair. I have chin length, thick, mostly straight, overprocessed hair.  I tried multiple cowashes, and this was finally my ahhh yes! Moment. I love the way this makes my hair feel. It doesn't make my roots feel greasier, but it makes my lengths feel much softer.  I really hope I can continue to find t

reviews.t: Very good for conditioning and detangling.
reviews.x: This is definitely better than others of the same type that I have tried.  It really moisturizes and cleans your hair and  scalp even though it it not a shampoo.Does an excellent job of detangling  Good for curly types of hair. Only downside is that I hate the scent.

Big bottle, great value.  I Only wash hair every 3+days. Use dry shampoo, leave in conditioners & other hair products... it still cleans hair with little bit product.  Sometimes repeat if hair is really dirty.  I have coarse thick wavy Latin hair. Hard to find products that work.  Usually have to buy ethnic products.  Love this one cuz moisture, cleans & helps curls to curl & be less frizzy. Will buy again

Love this product! My daughter and I have very thick and long hair. Our hair also frizzes. This co-wast is great but now it is hard to find. Seems like whenever we find a great product for our hair that really works, they start pulling it from the shelves.

Was using L’Oréal Cleanser. Looked for something cheaper in price and give it a try,found Aussie,I love it. I have long hair. Had to use 10 pumps of L’Oréal. I only use 2 pumps of the Aussie. It does the job and smells great.
This product is absolutely amazing! Coming from someone with extremely curly hair, it gets the knots out in seconds and leaves my hair so smooth!!
This product is really good for my dry curly hair. It gets my hair clean and it is conditioned. I just ordered a 3 pack.

reviews.t: Awesome product... curls with absolutely no styling!
reviews.x: My curls are shiny and bouncy! Scalp feels clean and no itching! Almost Everything makes my scalp itch!
Love this for my curls!! Doesn't strip oils from hair. Leaves hair super soft.

I’ve got thick dense curly frizzy hair (lucky me!) that always seems to get tangled. I love this cowash!  I can’t describe how amazing my hair feels when I rinse this out and the smell is awesome!  I usually switch up shampoos/conditioners once in a while but I’m on my 9th straight bottle of this and don’t feel my hair needs a change.

This product is wonderful. When time for me to wash my hair, but I don't have time, this Co-Wash really stopps my itchy scalp and helps manage my hair until wash day. It's really good for that. And it leaves my hair really, really soft, fingers running through hair soft. It's really great.

I wash my hair every 3rd day. On the 2nd day i use Miracle curls co-wash. It really helps clean and condition in one step and makes my hair manageable and enhances my curls. Love this stuff! Hope you never stop making it !

Best hair product I’ve found in awhile! My hair is very dry and brittle. I use  this and it seems to cleanse without stripping. My hair feels softer and more full.I don’t even need a conditioner afterward

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for leaving hair soft, moisturized, and manageable, especially for curly, wavy, or coarse hair.
Many reviewers highlight the great value and fair price, noting it performs as well as or better than more expensive brands.
Several reviewers say it cleans effectively without stripping oils, though a few report it does not clean well or lather easily.
Some reviewers mention the scent positively as nice and not overwhelming, while one reviewer dislikes it.
A few reviewers note issues with the product containing silicones or receiving an incorrect/different item in their order.
